artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the blue screen interface is illegible and slightly warped, lacking the crisp pixel alignment expected from a real digital display. It resembles AI-generated pseudo-text.
The central button lacks the distinct physical separation or shadow gap usually present between the button and the touch ring; it appears slightly fused or overly smooth.

The junction where the white iPod meets the black case and the silver connector area is geometrically ambiguous. The edges bleed into each other, and the connector port structure looks melted or ill-defined rather than mechanically precise.
